The '''''Arnold Mathematical Journal''''' is a quarterly [[Peer reviewed journal|peer-reviewed]] [[mathematics journal]] established in 2014. It is organized jointly by the [[Institute for Mathematical Sciences (Stony Brook University)|Institute for Mathematical Sciences]] at [[Stony Brook University]], USA, and [https://amathr.org/publications/journals/ Association for Mathematical Research]. The journal's [[editor-in-chief]] is [[Sergei Tabachnikov]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://armj.math.stonybrook.edu/|title=Editorial Board of Arnold Mathematical Journal}}</ref> The journal is [[abstracting and indexing|abstracted and indexed]] in [[ZbMATH]] and [[Scopus]].<ref>{{cite MIAR |title=Arnold Mathematical Journal |issn=2199-6792 |access-date=2019-09-04}}</ref>

The journal is named after the mathematician [[Vladimir Arnold]], with the choice of name intended as "a declaration that the journal should serve to maintain and promote the scientific style characteristic for Arnold's best mathematical works."<ref>{{citation|journal=Arnold Mathematical Journal|volume=1|issue=1|year=2015|pages=1–3|title=Journal Description Arnold Mathematical Journal|author=Editorial|doi=10.1007/s40598-015-0006-6|doi-access=free}}.</ref>
